metadata.title: A planar program for the two-variable Jacobian conjecture: a theorem ladder, staircase transport, and machine certificates at the (72,108) frontier
metadata.description:
Paper B of a three-paper research record. The two-variable Jacobian conjecture remains open after the 2026 counterexample in dimension 3. This paper develops an exact-arithmetic campaign on the lone open degree pair (72,108) below 125, built on Guccione-Guccione-Horruitiner-Valqui (arXiv:2204.14178, Proposition 4.3). Version 0.30 closes one declared four-coefficient restriction inside the 24-parameter cyclic core. The complete weighted three-parameter T_B cover is retained. Restoring direction (2,9), exact divisor norms and finite maximal-minor atlases close the complete A nonzero rational graph and its reduced 90-dimensional principal-open base algebra. Returning to the original 302-by-125 augmented matrix before invariant division, the direct A=0 boundary has two exact maximal minors independent of C. Their B-divisors are (5B+4)^3(25B^2-20B+16)^3 and B^95(109375B^6-110592)(21875B^6-4800B^3-24576), up to nonzero rational scalars, and an explicit Bezout identity proves unit gcd. Together with the separate d=0 quotient cover, this closes the complete declared four-coefficient restriction. The 24-parameter core, full 51-parameter family, complete (72,108) case, planar degree floor, and JC(2) remain open.

All scripts, artifacts and verdicts: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH (problems/algebraic-geometry/jacobian-conjecture).
